mainEntity.name: Is this an AI receptionist for restoration companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Kaico Voice is an AI receptionist built for water and fire restoration companies. It answers 24/7 with your company name, captures the address, the source and the carrier, transfers an active loss to your on-call cell, books everything else into your Google Calendar and sends you a text or email summary after each call. It tells callers it is an AI, and you can hear it yourself at (918) 359-2644.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle insurance questions on the call?

acceptedAnswer.text: The agent captures the carrier and whether a claim has been opened, and nothing more. It never gives coverage advice, never says what will or will not be paid, and never speaks for the insurer. That conversation is yours.

mainEntity.name: Can the phone route to my on-call tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You set the rule: active water, sewage or fire damage transfers to the on-call number immediately, with the address and the source already captured. Everything else books onto the calendar or becomes a message for your team to return.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, inside Front Door + Growth at $1,750 a month; you pay the ad spend. For restoration we recommend a spend only after the scoping audit, because the referral network usually pays back faster than the click. See Google Ads for contractors.
